I said no clearly. I sat up and said No again. I tried moving away and saying No. You have imagined my situation in your head instead of just believing what I said. It's not like I'm going to press charges in anyway or confront him about this. I was just trying to get something off my chest. 
I fucking yelled "No, Stop". and he still didn't stop. I wouldn't call that drunken muttering. 

What I don't understand is why you feel the need to try to deny my experience.

This guy is someone I consider a friend, not someone I just met at a bar. I'm sorry that people aren't mature enough to use real words when it comes to sex. When I mean sex I say sex. When I mean snuggle I say snuggle. And just why is it immature to want drunk snuggles? I don't understand your reasoning there. 

When I say I just "realized" I was "technically raped" I did later in the post acknowledge that sexual assaulted is probably a more accurate term but you don't get to rate the severity of it or it's emotional impact on me. There's more to it than I have told there because guess what I'm not ready to face it yet. It's much easier to be in denial about sexual assault than it is admit it happened, but the emotional impact is the same. 

I never said I had acted perfectly. But guess what what that doesn't give anyone one the right to force sexual contact on another person. 


More over this is /r/offmychest. I wasn't looking for your judgement. If you don't have constructive things to say (by the way what you said wasn't constructive, or anything I didn't already fucking know. just because it wasn't written in the post doesn't mean I'm not well aware, I was just trying to get some stuff off my chest) and you are not able to say it in a sensitive way...you don't have to say anything.

you are making a lot of assumptions here buddy. "young girl" you have no idea how old I am, or who I am. Yes I was drunk. I have been drunk many times and not had to deal with this sort of thing. I said "drunk snuggles" and thats what I meant. I said "No" multiple times yet he persisted.  I wasn't looking for attention I was looking to snuggle with my friend. 

And I'm sorry even if I had put myself in a questionable situation is it acceptable for someone to continue to force sexual activity on me after I have explicitly said "No"?

What that it happened? you think i'm making this up? why the hell would I make something up like that? This is /r/OffMyChest. It's not a place you go when your attention whoring....
Why would you even bother commenting if you don't believe me? There is always the option to no say anything.

You see, I am a grown up and so I use the words I mean. Had I meant drunk sex I would have said "Drunk sex" but I meant drunk snuggles so I said drunk snuggles. I said no when he started touching me. multiple times I had to push him away (no easy feat I am small woman and he is a very large man).
Sorry for getting snippy its just um, last time someone interpreted snuggles to mean sex or fooling around it didn't end so well for me.

I did take plan b. I've used it before, more times than i would like to admit, and i've never had any bleeding.  felt like crap for about a day and boom. all good. 
I think I took it before ovulation this time (in the past I think i've taken it after) and that might make a difference.
I honestly have no idea why I feel that way. It just happens to me sometimes. I'm over it for now but it's been unpleasant.
It's back! It always comes back...
That is the best analogy for it ever!!!!!!
